title: Q-KIT-PROVENANCE-1: carry PROVENANCE-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/autonomy/system.json::not_in_kit
**Status:** open

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule PROVENANCE-1 (Provenance is first-class: every input and change records where it came from and what it d) is enforced only by the platform (dashboard/provenance.js, dashboard/test/dashboard.test.mjs, doctrine/provenance.json). A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code here that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces PROVENANCE-1 into seed/ (a script under seed/scripts/, a tick step under seed/worker/src/, or a test under seed/tests/), add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove PROVENANCE-1 from not_in_kit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cd seed && python3 scripts/system.py --gaps prints no line for PROVENANCE-1, and python3 scripts/system.py --check passes.
